gri_path: Multiple different articles, not a GRI 3(b) set: classify the first-named article, metal slitting saws
GRI 1: heading 8202 expressly covers blades for saws of all kinds, including slitting or slotting saw blades; this is more specific than milling tools of 8207.70
GRI 6: 8202.3 circular saw blades (including slitting or slotting saw blades) > 8202.31.00.00 with working part of steel

milling tools; heading 8202 names slitting saw blades specifically
taps and threading tools, drills and reamers are other articles to be classified separately

missing_facts: What is the working part of the slitting saws made of (steel/HSS vs. cemented carbide)?
classify separately: taps and threading tools (8207.40), drills (8207.50), reamers and boring tools (8207.60), milling tools (8207.70)
classification.rationale: The description lists several different interchangeable metalworking tools that are not a retail set, so the first-named article, metal slitting saws, is classified. Heading 8202 expressly names slitting and slotting saw blades, and subheading 8202.31 covers circular saw blades with a working part of steel, giving 8202.31.00.00 on the assumption of HSS blades. The other tools fall in the heading 8207 subheadings for their kind. No precedent ruling specific to slitting saws was found in the searches.
